title: Bitcoin Legacy Addresses
description: Validates and decodes a legacy Bitcoin Base58Check address (P2PKH or P2SH). Trims surrounding whitespace but preserves case. Returns valid, address, encoding, network, possibleNetworks, type, version, and a lowercase 20-byte hash on success; returns valid:false, error, message otherwise. Testnet, signet and regtest cannot be distinguished by their legacy prefixes. SegWit is explicitly unsupported. This is format/checksum validation, not proof of Bitcoin usage, ownership, balance, safety, or investment value; other chains can share prefixes.

address.description: Case-sensitive legacy Bitcoin address; surrounding whitespace is ignored.
